name: wireboard-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your WireBoard analytics in plain language: live and historical visitors, top pages, referrers, countries, devices, custom events and campaigns, through the official read-only WireBoard MCP server. Needs a WireBoard API token.

wireboard_token.title: WireBoard API token
wireboard_token.description: Lets Claude read your analytics. Create one at https://wireboard.io/dashboard/settings/api with the analytics:read and live:read abilities. You can change it later in /plugin, Installed tab, WireBoard Analytics MCP, Configure options.
